label: Fix short declarations dropped in ast-chunker.ts when chunks.length === 0
summary: Fixed bug in AST chunker where the first (or only) short declaration was silently dropped when no preceding chunk existed (chunks.length === 0). Added an else branch to emit the short declaration as a standalone chunk instead of skipping it.

changes.kind: Added else branch in short-declaration handling for chunks.length === 0 case

handoff_notes: The short-declaration handling in ast-chunker.ts now has three branches: declLines >= minLines (standalone chunk), chunks.length > 0 (merge into preceding), and chunks.length === 0 (emit as standalone chunk). All existing tests pass without modification.
